pattern.description: A flat brand-navy panel slides in from the right across live-action footage, fully covering it, and the headline then fades in word by word on the panel.
pattern.why_premium: A fast, hard-edged brand-colour wipe gives a clean break from footage to typography without a dissolve, and the headline starting only once the panel lands keeps the hand-off readable.

build_hint.gsap: Panel: gsap.fromTo('.panel', {xPercent: 100}, {xPercent: 0, duration: 0.35, ease: 'power3.out'}); then headline words: gsap.fromTo('.headline .word', {opacity: 0}, {opacity: 1, duration: 0.4, ease: 'power1.out', stagger: 0.12}) starting at panel end.
build_hint.remotion: Panel translateX = interpolate(spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 200, stiffness: 180, mass: 1}}), [0, 1], [width, 0]); each word opacity = interpolate(frame - panelEnd - i * 3, [0, 10], [0, 1], {extrapolateLeft: 'clamp', extrapolateRight: 'clamp', easing: Easing.out(Easing.quad)}).

notes: Filmstrip is cropped to the left strip (b01); the end of a right-to-left wipe that began earlier. b02 OCR box covers only 'P'; it is used for the whole headline whose later words show graduated opacity in the end frame (word-staggered fade still in progress). Camera move is none; pan values describe the panel, not the camera.
